# privacy-scan allow-list (read by .github/scripts/privacy-scan.py).
#   value <string>        a known-safe value, allowed in every file (exact match, case-insensitive)
#   skip <rule|*> <glob>  do not apply a rule to matching paths (rules: mac ipv4 email key nm name blob)
# Only generic, documented values belong here. Never add a value that belongs to one device or one person's
# network (serial numbers, MAC / Bluetooth addresses, network names): fix the file instead.
#
# Licence and notice texts carry their authors' published addresses.
skip email *Notice-*.txt
skip email *NOTICE*
skip email *LICENSE*
skip email *COPYING*
#
# USB network gadget link used by the RAM-boot tools (the postmarketOS convention: device .1, PC .2).
value 172.16.42.1
value 172.16.42.1/24
value 172.16.42.2
#
# GNOME Shell extension UUID (not an address).
value background-logo@fedorahosted.org
#
# Bluetooth address placeholders that iceland-provision refuses (generic, the same in every unit's firmware / DT):
# the device tree's local-bd-address placeholder and the WCN NVM default, both byte orders.
value 25:00:00:00:5A:AD
value AD:5A:00:00:00:25
value 00:00:00:00:5A:AD
value AD:5A:00:00:00:00
# The WCN7860 Bluetooth controller's built-in default address (what the chip reports before an address is set;
# iceland-bdaddr treats it as a placeholder). Shared by every unit; not this tablet's address. Both byte orders.
value 78:55:00:01:5A:AD
value AD:5A:01:00:55:78
#
# The documentation example address (format examples in comments and help texts).
value aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff
#
# Upstream AppStream metadata of Fedora-derived packages carries the upstream projects' contact addresses.
skip email packaging/libcamera/qcam.metainfo.xml
skip email packaging/gstreamer1-plugins-good/gstreamer-good.appdata.xml
